tame verb

make an animal tame

also break in (a horse), domesticate, train (an animal)

classical

Varr. RR 1.20.2: bovēs (Lewis & Short)
Cic. ND 2.161: ferās bēluās (Lewis & Short)
Sall. Jug. 75.4: pecus (Lewis & Short)

domō, domāre, domuī, domitum

verb, first conjugation

tame, break in

Other words

  • mānsuēfaciō, mānsuēfacere, mānsuēfēcī, mānsuēfactum — make tame

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Quint. 9.4.5: mānsuēfacimus animālia? indomita nāscuntur (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • mānsuēfacimus animālia? indomita nāscuntur

    do we tame animals? they are born untamedQuint. 9.4.5 (Lewis & Short)

See also tame, wild, horse, ox.
